proof_body:
by
  intro T _ f g h
  have hint : ∀ u : C(AddCircle T, ℂ), MeasureTheory.Integrable u AddCircle.haarAddCircle := fun u => u.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have h0 : ∀ n : ℤ, fourierCoeff ((f - g : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) : AddCircle T → ℂ) n = 0 := by
    intro n
    have e : ((f - g : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) : AddCircle T → ℂ) = (f : AddCircle T → ℂ) + (fun x => (-1 : ℂ) * g x) := by
      funext x; simp; ring
    rw [e, fourierCoeff.add (hint f) ((hint g).const_mul _), Pi.add_apply, fourierCoeff.const_mul, h n]
    ring
  have hs : Summable (fourierCoeff ((f - g : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) : AddCircle T → ℂ)) := by
    have : fourierCoeff ((f - g : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) : AddCircle T → ℂ) = 0 := funext h0
    rw [this]; exact summable_zero
  have hsum := hasSum_fourier_series_of_summable hs
  have : (f - g : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) = 0 := by
    refine hsum.unique ?_
    have : (fun i : ℤ => fourierCoeff ((f - g : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) : AddCircle T → ℂ) i • (fourier i : C(AddCircle T, ℂ))) = 0 := by
      funext i; rw [h0 i, zero_smul]; rfl
    rw [this]; exact hasSum_zero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
target_source: ∀ (T : ℝ) [hT : Fact (0 < T)] (f g : C(AddCircle T, ℂ)), (∀ n : ℤ, fourierCoeff f n = fourierCoeff g n) → f = g
